-- REQ: LANG-1561 LANG-1562 LANG-1563 LANG-1564 (* Greets the user. *) property greeting : "Hello" on greet(theName, times) set theText to greeting & ", " & theName & "!" repeat with i from 1 to times display dialog theText end repeat return length of theText end greet tell application "Finder" activate if (count of windows) > 0 and true then set w to name of front window end if end tell greet("world", 2)
